EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows, equal square cells, transparent 1536x1536 canvas, generous gutters, all art wholly contained. No character, hands, text, labels or borders. Row1 col1 inventory icon of complete gun diagonally, col2 held ready gun horizontally aimed RIGHT, col3 gun firing/recoil horizontally RIGHT with short separate-at-tip cyan water pulse. Row2 col1 gun recovered horizontal RIGHT same grip anchor and same scale as ready, col2 isolated compact cyan water-bolt projectile elongated RIGHT, col3 second frame same water bolt with slightly changed droplets. No gray haze, gradients behind sprites or ground shadow. This is an asset sheet, not a marketing illustration.
